title: Silah signed result bundle
description: What a genomics lab issues to ONE person after a premarital test or a couple re-check. The partner's findings never appear, except the genes both partners carry.

keyId.description: First 16 hex characters of SHA-256 of the lab's Ed25519 public key.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (RFC 8032), base64url without padding, over the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical JSON of payload (keys sorted, no whitespace).

gene.description: Current HGNC symbol on the DoH panel.

variant.description: HGVS c. notation or a copy-number description.

tag.description: Gene-specific allele class, e.g. HBB: HbS | HbC | b0 | b+.

shared.description: Genes in which BOTH partners carry a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant.

partnerNegativeFor.description: This person's own carrier genes for which the partner tested negative. Nothing else about the partner.

vusGenes.description: Genes where a variant of uncertain significance matters for the couple; routed to a counsellor first.

detection.description: What the lab states about its own tests, from its validation. Without it the phone gives every remaining chance as a range (99% to 80% detection), never one personal figure.

panel.description: Share of a gene's pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants the panel detects.

genes.description: Genes with their own validated rate, for example CYP21A2 or HBA1/HBA2.

exactChange.description: This person's carrier genes for which the lab checked the partner's sample for this person's exact variant, with that check's sensitivity. A gene not listed was covered by the panel only.

fraction.description: An exact fraction n/d, both as decimal integer strings.
